summary.name: Lovable
summary.one_liner: Lovable is an AI app and website builder where you describe software in plain language and it generates full-stack apps, websites and internal tools.
use_cases: Building a new product from a plain-language description
Creating internal tools for a company
Replacing custom SaaS subscriptions with in-house apps
Adding payments and authentication to an app without writing integration code
summary.what_it_does: Lovable takes a plain-language description and builds production-style software with the user in real time, with iterative refinement of the design before deployment. It states that it handles hosting, SSL, backend infrastructure, authentication, and payments, including local payments, currency conversion, and tax compliance in 200+ countries and territories. It offers connections to existing tech stacks and tools, and says automatic security scans and audit logs are included. The page says projects can be built and managed on web, desktop, and mobile.
notable: Handles hosting, SSL, backend, authentication and payments end to end
Payments with tax compliance across 200+ countries and territories
Connects to existing tools without integration code
Automatic security scans and audit logs
caveats: Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; the listing says it is free to start
Page is largely marketing claims and customer case studies with few technical specifics
